judgments.reason: The candidate is the figshare record (DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.7636301) by Tianyu Jia, the same source DOI listed in the dataset. It describes the motor imagery EEG data from stroke patients, so it is another deposit of the same data.
judgments.paper_title: EEG data of motor imagery for stroke

judgments.reason: PA-TCNet (2026) proposes a cross-subject decoding method for stroke motor-imagery EEG and likely uses this dataset. It does not introduce or release the Jia 2019 data.
judgments.paper_title: PA-TCNet: Pathology-Aware Temporal Calibration with Physiology-Guided Target Refinement for Cross-Subject Motor Imagery EEG Decoding in Stroke Patients

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, not a paper describing the Jia2019 stroke motor-imagery dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a data-organization standard/specification used to format the dataset, not a paper describing the stroke motor-imagery recordings.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
